description: Group 1 (ACCDB DAO): leading U+FEFF followed by Latin-1 (3, 4, 5, 20 e-acute), wide (3, 20, 31, 32, 100 euro crossing Memo 64B inline/LVAL boundary), mixed (x-euro-x, 10x-euro, euro-10x), doubled U+FEFF, U+FEFF+U+FFFE, embedded NUL, and plain controls into TU (uncompressed) and TC (WITH COMPRESSION). Keeps whole file before and after write.
retentionNote: Group 1 ACCDB DAO non-ASCII/wide/BOM/embedded-NUL: verbatim ff fe for all uncompressed Text/Memo and incompressible compressed Text/Memo (including 66B single-page LVAL euros and embedded NUL).
